supersessions.reason: Retained byte-for-byte as source history but not part of the current production migration chain. It targets the legacy public.* schema and its 12 RLS policies depend on the Supabase auth.uid() function, which does not exist on Neon PostgreSQL. The current runtime uses the raf.* schema with workspace-context isolation, and its integrity and security requirements are represented by the raf.* architecture in the superseding migrations. Some legacy imported_transaction_rows foreign-key columns were intentionally abandoned during that redesign rather than mapped one-to-one. The old allocation-trigger implementation also contains the historical NEW.income_entry_id defect on income_entries. Whether this migration was ever attempted in production is not independently established here; the declared expectation is only that it is absent from the migration ledger.
